description: [Auth Required] Stop the agent's active timelog on a KalEvent. NO time cap — real elapsed minutes (now - start) are authoritative. Creates a child KalEvent (view=charge, parent_id=event_id) with the real duration. Returns the finalized UserTime + child event.

event_id.description: KalEvent ID the timer was started on

label.description: Optional label for the timelog / resulting child event

name: timelog-stop
title: Stop Timelog On Event
